verdict.rationale: Sentry documents a programmatic web API, but nothing in the evidence shows a downloadable OpenAPI or equivalent machine-readable spec. The probe found every candidate OpenAPI/Swagger path returning 404. The llms.txt file is documentation for LLMs, not an API spec, so it is an adjacent feature and earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
